parameters.content:
## start_seo_article
Uses one saved article plan to choose a topic, collect only essential details, and queue a grounded review draft. No publishing.

parameters.jsCode: const uuid=/^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[1-5][0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i;const sessionId=String($json.sessionId??'').trim(),requestId=String($json.requestId??'').trim();let domain=String($json.domain??'').trim().toLowerCase().replace(/^https?:\/\//,'').split('/')[0].replace(/^www\./,'').replace(/\.$/,'');const labels=domain.split('.');const primaryKeyword=String($json.primaryKeyword??'').trim().slice(0,200),chooseStrongestKeyword=$json.chooseStrongestKeyword===true;const selectionNumber=Number($json.selectionNumber||0);const supportingKeywords=String($json.supportingKeywords??'').split(/[,\n]/).map(v=>v.trim()).filter(Boolean).slice(0,20);const sourceUrls=String($json.sourceUrls??'').split(/[\s,]+/).map(v=>v.trim()).filter(Boolean).slice(0,12);let error=null;if(!uuid.test(sessionId)||!uuid.test(requestId))error={code:'INVALID_REQUEST',message:'The article needs a valid conversation.'};else if(!domain||domain.includes('@')||domain.includes(':')||labels.length<2||labels.some(l=>!/^[a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9-]{0,61}[a-z0-9])?$/.test(l)))error={code:'INVALID_DOMAIN',message:'Use a complete public business domain such as example.com.'};else if(selectionNumber&&(!Number.isInteger(selectionNumber)||selectionNumber<1||selectionNumber>3))error={code:'INVALID_SELECTION',message:'Choose article 1, 2 or 3.'};else if(sourceUrls.some(v=>!/^https:\/\/[a-z0-9.-]+(?:\/[^\s]*)?$/i.test(v)||v.includes('@')||/:\d+(?:\/|$)/.test(v)))error={code:'INVALID_SOURCE',message:'Article sources must be complete public HTTPS links.'};const clean=(value,limit=1000)=>String(value??'').trim().slice(0,limit);return{json:{valid:!error,sessionId,requestId,domain,primaryKeyword,selectionNumber,chooseStrongestKeyword,supportingKeywords,targetAudience:clean($json.targetAudience),offer:clean($json.offer),price:clean($json.price),boundaries:clean($json.boundaries),voice:clean($json.voice),goal:clean($json.goal),sourceUrls,...(error?{response:{ok:false,error}}:{})}};

const input=$('Validate Article Brief').first().json,body=$json.body??$json.data??{},status=Number($json.statusCode??0),job=body.job;if(status>=200&&status<300&&['needs_selection','needs_details'].includes(body.status))return{json:{...input,registered:false,response:{ok:true,status:body.status,message:body.message,missingFields:body.missingFields??[],articleBrief:body.brief}}};if(status<200||status>=300||!job?.jobId){const message=String(body?.error?.message??'I could not prepare the article safely. Nothing was written.');return{json:{...input,registered:false,response:{ok:false,error:{code:'ARTICLE_QUEUE_FAILED',message}}}};}return{json:{...input,registered:true,created:body.created===true,jobId:job.jobId,job,articleBrief:body.brief,primaryKeyword:job.primaryKeyword,supportingKeywords:job.supportingKeywords}};

const i=$('Check Job Registration').first().json,status=i.created?'queued':i.job.status;const messages={queued:'I’m writing and checking the article now. Its progress will appear in the chat.',running:'That article is already being written. Its progress will appear in the chat.',completed:'That article is ready to download.',partial:'That article is ready with a short warning.',failed:'That earlier article attempt needs attention.',interrupted:'That earlier article attempt stopped before it finished.'};return{json:{...i,response:{ok:true,status,jobId:i.jobId,domain:i.domain,primaryKeyword:i.primaryKeyword,articleBrief:i.articleBrief,message:messages[status]??messages.queued}}};

const base=$('Validate Article Brief').first().json,r=$json.response??{ok:false,error:{code:'ARTICLE_QUEUE_FAILED',message:'The article could not be queued.'}};return{json:{occurredAt:new Date().toISOString(),sessionId:base.sessionId,requestId:base.requestId,toolName:'start_seo_article',proposedInput:JSON.stringify({domain:base.domain,primaryKeyword:base.primaryKeyword,selectionNumber:base.selectionNumber,chooseStrongestKeyword:base.chooseStrongestKeyword}),result:JSON.stringify(r),error:r.ok===false?String(r.error?.message??'Tool failed'):'',response:r}};
const p=$('Prepare Audit').item.json,r={...p.response};if(!Number.isInteger($json.id))r.auditWarning='The start could not be written to the local audit table.';return{json:r};
